preToolUse.bash: if [ -z "${COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ]; then exit 0; fi; if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then PY=python3; elif command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then PY=python; else exit 0; fi; "$PY" "$COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/copilot-mention-guard.py"
preToolUse.powershell: if (-not $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT) { exit 0 }; $py = $null; foreach ($candidate in @('python3','python','py')) { foreach ($found in $ExecutionContext.SessionState.InvokeCommand.GetCommands($candidate, [System.Management.Automation.CommandTypes]::Application, $false)) { if ($found.Source -notmatch '\\WindowsApps\\') { $py = $found; break } }; if ($py) { break } }; if (-not $py) { exit 0 }; & $py.Source (Join-Path $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT 'scripts\copilot-mention-guard.py')
